coverage.note: Invalid value is rejected, set and remove both work.
Dynamic set is rejected with InvalidConfigurationException; static '*' has no effect.
Waits for the controller to see the cordoned count change after dynamic set and unset.
Both createTopics and createPartitions are asserted.
Asserts IneligibleReplicaException and that keeping an existing replica is allowed.
alterReplicaLogDirs to the cordoned dir fails with InvalidReplicaAssignmentException.
getOrCreateLog with the cordoned dir id suggested lands in the uncordoned dir.
Admin isCordoned() is asserted but LogDirsCommand output is untested; add a LogDirsCommandTest that checks the printed field.
Per-dir gauge and count gauge are asserted both when cordoned and when uncordoned.

findings.text: With every live dir cordoned, nextLogDirs() returns an empty list and creating a replica fails with 'No log directories available'. This case is untested, and in the isFuture path a cordoned suggested dir throws IllegalStateException.

There are no unit tests for BrokerRegistration, the record cloneWith, BrokerLifecycleManager heartbeat gating or ConfigurationControlManager, although the request asked for unit tests of the changed pieces.
The old three-argument cloneWith overload could be dropped by updating its callers, to avoid duplicate API.

summary: The behaviour holds. My three probes (multi-broker placement and errors, single-broker dir and metrics, old metadata version) all pass. ACC20 is partial because the log dirs tool output has no test.
